assignments.value:
Cross-border investment origination and capital markets professional with 10+ years of experience connecting Asian capital with international investment opportunities across China, Hong Kong, and international markets. Specialised in deal sourcing, investor engagement, and capital formation, with a strong track record of introducing institutional investors, family offices, and UHNWIs into private market opportunities across infrastructure, energy, and advanced manufacturing. Fluent in Mandarin and English, with deep China experience and established relationships across family offices, private equity, and government-linked investment ecosystems. Currently advancing technical investment knowledge through CAIA Level I.
Experience
2025.06 - Present
The Victorian Government in Hong Kong, Trade and Invest Manager, Hong Kong
Lead end-to-end deal origination and execution support for cross-border investment opportunities, spanning opportunity structuring, investor targeting, and capital engagement
Advise project sponsors and fund managers on investment positioning, commercial narrative development, and investor readiness, ensuring alignment with institutional and family office expectations
Develop and manage relationships with family offices, private equity funds, and institutional investors, cultivating deal interest and progressing opportunities through the pipeline
Drive investor engagement processes, including initial outreach, relationship development, and ongoing dialogue to build conviction and advance transactions
Supported capital syndication for a 480MW Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project, facilitating engagement across multiple investor groups and contributing to a broader multi-million dollar financing process
Act as a bridge between capital and opportunity, aligning investor appetite with project structuring and execution strategy
2024.02 - 2025.05
Altios International, Head of Development - Greater China, Shanghai/Hong Kong
Led regional business development with a focus on cross-border investment and market entry projects for international clients
Generated a consistent pipeline of qualified investment and expansion opportunities, converting leads into long-term advisory engagements
Structured and negotiated outbound investment (ODI) initiatives for Chinese corporates, including strategic partnerships with financial institutions
Advised clients across healthcare, manufacturing, and FMCG on expansion strategies and capital deployment in Asia-Pacific markets
2020.03 - 2024.02
Acclime, Sales Manager - China, Shanghai/Beijing
Drove client acquisition across Europe (DACH region), supporting market entry, structuring, and investment setup in China
Secured mandates including manufacturing investments, entity setups, and finance outsourcing projects
Built C-suite relationships and advised on cross-border operational and investment strategy
Developed thought leadership initiatives and investor-facing events to strengthen deal flow and pipeline generation
2016.09 - 2020.03
Australian Chamber of Commerce - China, General Manager (Chengdu) & Senior Relationship Manager (Beijing)
Led investor engagement initiatives, facilitating cross-border investment dialogues between Chinese corporates and international stakeholders
Secured participation in an oil & gas delegation resulting in a USD 120M MOU, involving BRI-linked investors
Built and maintained relationships with key government bodies (MOFCOM, MOCA), supporting investment facilitation and policy navigation
Expanded membership base by 50%, strengthening access to corporate and investor networks
2016.09 - 2020.03
Hengtu Technology/Fotor - Chengdu, Marketing Manager
Executed international marketing campaigns targeting Western markets, driving user growth for Fotor's photography app and website.
Partnered with the Australian Consulate in Chengdu to launch the "Australia-China Sister City Competition," earning formal commendation.
Collaborated with product and legal teams to localize content and draft international partnership agreements.
Key Initiatives
AI-Driven Lead Generation: Scripted custom Python pipelines that delivered an additional 3 qualified leads per month for both Altios and the Victorian Government.
Bespoke Advisory for Fundraising: Provided tailored advisory to Australian PE/VC firms on appealing to Hong Kong family offices, private equity, and venture capital investors - work expected to result in major inbound investment.
Data-Driven Investor Sourcing: Scraped and analyzed the entire Hong Kong SFC database to build a proprietary pipeline of institutional prospects.
Thought Leadership: Delivered keynote addresses and panel contributions at numerous trade and investment events, positioning as a recognized voice in cross-border advisory and investment promotion.
Education
Latrobe University, Melbourne - Bachelor of Asian Studies & Politics
Sichuan University, Chengdu - Advanced Mandarin Studies (HSK 6)
Southwest University of Minorities, Chengdu - Intermediate Mandarin Studies (HSK 4)
Professional Certifications: CEH Level 1 coursework; CompTIA Network+ & Security+
In Progress: Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst (CAIA) Level I

=Candidate resume and profile:
{{ $json.resumeText }}

Target job tiers (ground truth) -- INVESTMENT-FOCUSED ROLES ONLY, no trade facilitation/trade policy/trade commissioner roles:
Tier 1 (direct match - prioritize): Head of Investment Promotion (InvestHK, EDB, FDI agencies); Director, China Desk/Greater China (law firms, Big 4, mid-market IB); Head of Investor Relations (PE/VC/infra funds); Director, Capital Formation (infra/energy/renewables); Director, Cross-Border Investment Advisory.
Tier 2 (adjacent - include): Investment Director/Principal (infra/energy); Head of Family Office Relations; Corporate Development/Strategy (China-facing, investment-led).
Tier 3 (stretch - include but lower priority): Impact/Climate investment origination; Sovereign wealth liaison; Boutique cross-border investment advisory partner; Head of Asia for Australian asset manager.

Produce the taxonomy JSON now.

options.systemMessage: You are a career strategist. Given a resume and a set of target job tiers (ground truth), output a JSON object with three arrays: tier1_direct, tier2_adjacent, tier3_stretch. Each entry must be: { "title": string, "seniority": string, "alternate_titles": string[], "search_keywords": string[], "rationale": string }. Use the target tiers as ground truth - do not invent unrelated roles. The candidate wants INVESTMENT-focused roles ONLY: investor relations, investment promotion/attraction, capital formation/origination, fund/family office/investment management, or investment-focused cross-border advisory. Do NOT include trade facilitation, trade policy, trade commissioner, general government affairs, or general country-manager/BD roles that are not investment-specific. Exclude pure IB/PE associate/VP roles (no modelling track record), pure tech roles, pure marketing roles, and single-sector specialist roles. Return VALID JSON ONLY, no markdown, no commentary, no code fences.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"tier1_direct":[{"title":"Trade and Investment Commissioner","seniority":"Director","alternate_titles":["Trade Commissioner","Investment Commissioner","Director of Trade & Investment"],"search_keywords":["trade commissioner","investment commissioner","greater china","FDI"],"rationale":"Direct match to current government trade & investment mandate."}],"tier2_adjacent":[{"title":"Investment Director","seniority":"Director","alternate_titles":["Investment Principal","Head of Origination"],"search_keywords":["investment director","infrastructure","energy"],"rationale":"Adjacent capital-formation role leveraging origination experience."}],"tier3_stretch":[{"title":"Head of Asia, Australian Asset Manager","seniority":"Head","alternate_titles":["Regional Director Asia"],"search_keywords":["head of asia","asset management","Australia"],"rationale":"Stretch role combining Australian ties with Greater China network."}]}

parameters.text: =Research the company "{{ $('Check Verified URL').item.json.company }}" which posted a job titled "{{ $('Check Verified URL').item.json.title }}". Verified careers page: {{ $('Check Verified URL').item.json.verifiedUrl }}. Additional context snippet: {{ $('Check Verified URL').item.json.exaSnippet }}

options.systemMessage: You are a company research analyst supporting a job search. Given a company name, a verified careers-page URL, and a search snippet, produce a concise structured summary. Base every field only on the provided information; if a field is not available, use "Unknown". Keep the summary factual, neutral, and written for a job-seeker doing due diligence before applying. Return VALID JSON ONLY, no markdown, no commentary, no code fences.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"summary":"Example three sentence company summary for due diligence.","industry":"Financial Services","size":"51-200 employees","hq":"Hong Kong","funding_stage":"Series B","recent_news":"Raised a Series B round in 2025."}

value.Reason: No verified live careers-page URL found via Exa

parameters.content:
## Apify Query Loop
Runs each taxonomy x location query through Apify (run-sync-get-dataset-items - blocks up to 120s, no manual polling needed). Results are tagged with query metadata and staged in the "job_discovery_raw_listings" Data Table so they can be deduped after ALL queries finish.

Swap actors: edit the "Config" node apifyActorId field, and update the body field names in "Run Apify Actor (sync)" to match that actor input schema.

## Listings Loop
For each deduped listing: Exa searches for the company careers page, "Check Verified URL" validates the top result actually looks like a live job posting (domain + path heuristics). Verified listings get AI company research and are upserted into "Job Pipeline" (keyed on Verified URL, so re-runs never duplicate). Unverified listings are logged to the "Unverified" tab instead of being discarded.
Run complete. Check the "Job Pipeline", "Unverified" and "Error Log" tabs in your Google Sheet.
